stem.en: I ___ my wallet yesterday, but a kind woman found it.

why.en: Yesterday is a finished past time, so we use the past simple (lost), not the present perfect.
why.uz: Yesterday — tugagan oʻtgan vaqt, shuning uchun Present Perfect emas, Past Simple (lost).
why.ru: Yesterday — законченное прошлое, поэтому Past Simple (lost), а не Present Perfect.

stem.en: Nodira ___ three books since the summer holidays started.

why.en: Since + a starting point links the past to now, so we need the present perfect: has read.
why.uz: Since + boshlanish nuqtasi oʻtmishni hozir bilan bogʻlaydi, shuning uchun Present Perfect: has read.
why.ru: Since + начальная точка связывает прошлое с настоящим, поэтому Present Perfect: has read.

why.en: A question with When asks about a finished past time, so it uses the past simple: did.
why.uz: When bilan savol tugagan oʻtgan vaqt haqida, shuning uchun Past Simple: did.
why.ru: Вопрос с When — о законченном моменте в прошлом, поэтому Past Simple: did.

options.en: I've known Aziz for five years.
I know Aziz for five years.
I've knew Aziz for five years.
I'm knowing Aziz for five years.

why.en: A state from the past until now with for uses the present perfect: I've known.
why.uz: Oʻtmishdan hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat for bilan Present Perfect da: I've known.
why.ru: Состояние, длящееся с прошлого до сих пор, с for — Present Perfect: I've known.

stem.en: You look hot. ___ you been running?

why.en: Been running is the present perfect continuous, so the question starts with Have.
why.uz: Been running — Present Perfect Continuous, shuning uchun savol Have bilan boshlanadi.
why.ru: Been running — Present Perfect Continuous, поэтому вопрос начинается с Have.

stem.en: She ___ for the bus for twenty minutes, and it still hasn't come.

why.en: An action that started in the past and is still going on, with for: has been waiting.
why.uz: Oʻtmishda boshlanib hali davom etayotgan harakat, for bilan: has been waiting.
why.ru: Действие началось в прошлом и всё ещё длится, с for: has been waiting.

stem.en: How long ___ learning to play the piano?

why.en: How long + an action continuing up to now: have you been + -ing.
why.uz: How long + hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat: have you been + -ing.
why.ru: How long + действие, длящееся до сих пор: have you been + -ing.

stem.en: My eyes hurt because I ___ at the computer all morning.

why.en: A recent long activity with a result now (my eyes hurt): have been + -ing.
why.uz: Yaqinda uzoq davom etgan va hozir natijasi bor harakat (koʻzim ogʻriyapti): have been + -ing.
why.ru: Недавнее длительное действие с результатом сейчас (глаза болят): have been + -ing.

stem.en: I didn't recognise my old classmate because he ___ so much.

why.en: He changed before I saw him (an earlier past), so we use the past perfect: had changed.
why.uz: U men koʻrishimdan oldin oʻzgargan (oldingi oʻtmish), shuning uchun Past Perfect: had changed.
why.ru: Он изменился раньше, чем я его увидел (более раннее прошлое), поэтому Past Perfect: had changed.

stem.en: She was hungry because she ___ anything since breakfast.

why.en: The story is in the past (was hungry), and the eating was before that: hadn't eaten.
why.uz: Voqea oʻtmishda (was hungry), ovqatlanish esa undan oldin: hadn't eaten.
why.ru: Рассказ в прошлом (was hungry), а еда была ещё раньше: hadn't eaten.

stem.en: By the time we arrived, everyone ___ home.

why.en: By the time + past shows that the other action happened earlier: had gone.
why.uz: By the time + oʻtgan zamon boshqa harakat undan oldin boʻlganini koʻrsatadi: had gone.
why.ru: By the time + прошедшее показывает, что другое действие было раньше: had gone.

options.en: Before 2020, we had never seen snow.
Before 2020, we have never seen snow.
Before 2020, we had never saw snow.
Before 2020, we hadn't never seen snow.

why.en: Experience up to a point in the past uses had + past participle: had never seen.
why.uz: Oʻtmishdagi bir nuqtagacha boʻlgan tajriba had + uchinchi shakl bilan: had never seen.
why.ru: Опыт до определённого момента в прошлом: had + третья форма: had never seen.

stem.en: When I was a child, I ___ play outside every day.

why.en: A past habit that has stopped: used to + the base verb.
why.uz: Toʻxtagan oʻtmishdagi odat: used to + feʼlning asosiy shakli.
why.ru: Прошлая привычка, которой больше нет: used to + начальная форма.

stem.en: ___ you use to walk to school?

why.en: Questions with used to are made with did, and then use to (no d): Did you use to...?
why.uz: Used to bilan savol did yordamida tuziladi, keyin use to (d siz): Did you use to...?
why.ru: Вопросы с used to строятся с did, а затем use to (без d): Did you use to...?

stem.en: There ___ be a cinema here, but now it's a supermarket.

why.en: For a past state (there was a cinema) we use used to; would is only for repeated actions.
why.uz: Oʻtmishdagi holat uchun (kinoteatr bor edi) used to; would faqat takrorlangan harakatlar uchun.
why.ru: Для прошлого состояния (здесь был кинотеатр) — used to; would — только для повторяющихся действий.

stem.en: My grandmother ___ like coffee, but now she drinks it every day.

why.en: The negative of used to is didn't use to + the base verb.
why.uz: Used to ning inkor shakli: didn't use to + feʼlning asosiy shakli.
why.ru: Отрицательная форма used to: didn't use to + начальная форма.
